name: Lisha Lockheart
original_name: リーシャ・ロックハート
source:
She is half Japanese and half English. She is a lustrous beauty with brown skin and shiny blond hair. She boasts an outstanding style. 

She is an artist and values her own intuition. She is a sucker for anything “kawaii,” and falls in love with the main character at first sight, approaching him every chance she gets. 

Although her career as an original artist is still in its infancy, her eye-catching compositions and angles are highly acclaimed. 

Breast shape :Cone shaped (torpedo boobs)
